title: Existence of finite Tate scalar balancing families

proof.text: Construct the degree-zero multiplication and positive-degree tensor-power coefficient maps sectionwise. The balancing relation gives well-defined inverse maps, and restriction compatibility gives sheaf isomorphisms; the explicit generator, unit and successor formulas establish the balancing predicate.

lean.statement:
theorem finite_tate_scalar_balancing_exists [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (hB : (N : B) = 0)
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (hX : ∀ x : X, IsUnit (N : X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    ∃ β : ∀ r : ℕ,
        (Etale.purityScalarSheaf φ X).obj (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateTwist X N A hA r) ≅
          Scheme.finiteEtaleTateTwist X N B hB r,
      IsFiniteTateScalarBalancing φ N hA hB X β
